viewing_check: Check the cleaver blade for the Dexter or Dexter-Russell stamp, depth of pitting and rust, cracks, and whether the handle is tight. For the apron, check whether the mesh is intact (no broken or missing rings), the rings are stainless, the straps and clips are sound, and the size. Photograph the maker tag on the apron if any.
